title: Package Deductible Coverage on the Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Loan Payoff Benefit
content:
**Package benefit.** In measuring the payoff shortfall on a vehicle surrendered as a total loss under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, the excluded deductible depends on the package of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy: on a policy written on Cardinal Auto Premier no deductible is excluded from the payoff shortfall; on a policy written on Cardinal Auto Preferred 50 percent of the decided deductible, rounded to the cent, is excluded; on every other package the full decided deductible is excluded.

The decided deductible is the deductible stated on the claim's latest accepted coverage decision. The package is read from the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy record.

| Package | Deductible excluded from the payoff shortfall |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Auto Premier | None |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | 50 percent of the decided deductible, rounded to the cent |
| Cardinal Auto Plus, Standard, Basic or Essential | The full decided deductible |

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

Decided deductible 750.00:
- Premier: 0.00 excluded.
- Preferred: 375.00 excluded.
- Plus: 750.00 excluded.

Decided deductible 0.00 (a waived deductible): nothing is excluded on any package.
